ELECTION ORDINANCE ADDENDUM July 14, 1997

SECTION I: DATE OF ELECTIONS (OCGA 21-3-51) The general Municipal elections shall be held November 4th, 1997.

SECTION III: NOTICE OF CANDIDACY (OCGA 21-3-91a) The qualifying dates for the 1997 Municipal election shall be no earlier than 8:30 a. m. and no later than 4 p.m. on Monday, September 8th, x Tuesday, September 9, Thursday, September 11 and Friday, September 12, 1997.

SECTION IV: QUALIFICATION FEE (OCGA 21-3-90a) The qualifying fees for the 1997 Municipal election shall be as follows: Mayor $54.00 “ Council $10.80

SECTION VII: ELECTORS H. Electors shall have registered on or before October, 1997.
